newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico's Sanluis started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico's Sanluis started as buy.

text.p: --Credit Lyonnais said Friday it intiated coverage of Mexican autoparts and mining concern Corporacion Industrial Sanluis with a buy recommnedation.
--Analyst David Bodenberg said, "We estimate 1996 net earnings of 406 million pesos ($51 million) will be sourced to $25-$30 million in auto parts and $21-$26 million in mining."
"The numbers deserve a buy rating," Bodenberg said in a report on the company.
Sanluis is hedged against economic uncertainty, for it brings together a niche auto parts company and a resource-rich gold and silver mining company, he said.
He added the former is suited to an economy showing balanced growth and the latter an economy that tips to recession or inflation.

"The above average price per book value of 3.2 times is simply a reflection of the high return on equity. Although net debt exceeds equity, the strength of earning power has led to interest coverage ratios far above Mexican norms," he said.
